resources.string: Turn SHIP into SHIPS to score 11 points.
Tap the S on the rack below the board.
It’s the square just to the right of SHIP. 2L doubles the value of S.
You can see your score before playing. Tap Play move to see the result.
Clear your placement, then place only the S on H12.
Well played. The 2L square doubled the value of S.
The first word covers the center star. After that, connect to a letter on the board. New tiles must form a single row or column. Every word you form must be in the dictionary used for that game.

Add the tile values of the words you form. 2L and L3 multiply a letter. 2W and 3W multiply the word. Bonuses apply the first time you cover a square. A blank tile is worth zero. Playing all seven tiles in one move earns 50 extra points.
NAB is your solo opponent. Its engine finds legal moves using the same dictionary as you. Adaptive difficulty uses your local Elo and the score difference during the game.
The game engine checks and explains the score. When several details are available, you can read them or ask NAB to pick one using the SmolLM2 model. The explanations work in airplane mode.

The standard English modes use ENABLE2K. For offline practice, import a word list you have permission to use in Profile → Settings → Personal dictionary. WESPA uses CSW24 for international tournaments. NASPA uses NWL2023 for its US and Canadian tournaments.
